description: Updates an existing milestone in a GitLab project, allowing you to modify the title, description, dates, or state. Use this action when you need to change milestone details, adjust deadlines, or close/reopen a milestone.

description.description: The new description of the milestone.
examples: This milestone tracks all tasks for the 2.0 release.
description.title: Description

due_date.description: The new due date of the milestone in YYYY-MM-DD format.
due_date.title: Due Date

id.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.
id.title: Id

milestone_id.description: The ID of the project's milestone to update.
milestone_id.title: Milestone Id

start_date.description: The new start date of the milestone in YYYY-MM-DD format.
start_date.title: Start Date

state_event.description: The state event to apply to the milestone. Use 'close' to close the milestone or 'activate' to reopen it.
state_event.title: State Event

title.description: The new title of the milestone.
title.title: Title

name: update_milestone

created_at.description: Timestamp of when the milestone was created.
created_at.title: Created At

due_date.description: The due date of the milestone.
due_date.title: Due Date

expired.description: Indicates whether the milestone has expired.
expired.title: Expired

iid.description: The internal ID of the milestone.
iid.title: Iid

project_id.description: The ID of the project the milestone belongs to.
project_id.title: Project Id

start_date.description: The start date of the milestone.
start_date.title: Start Date

state.description: The state of the milestone (e.g., active, closed).
state.title: State

updated_at.description: Timestamp of when the milestone was last updated.
updated_at.title: Updated At

web_url.description: The web URL of the milestone.
web_url.title: Web Url
